title: Plan: JPL DE backend
description:
Port swejpl.c (~958 lines). JPL DE file format reader. Optional cargo feature.

## File structure (catalogue-internal §4.1)
- Records 0-1: headers (title, constant names, epoch range ss[0]/ss[1]/ss[2], AU, Earth-Moon mass ratio, body index table ipt[39], DE version)
- Records 2+: Chebyshev coefficients for all bodies over one segment (~32 days)
- Body index table ipt[i×3]: start index, ncf (coefficients per component), na (sub-intervals per segment)
- 13 bodies: Mercury–Pluto, Moon, Sun, nutations, librations

## Core algorithm: interp() — Chebyshev evaluation
Same Clenshaw recurrence as Phase 2, but with sub-interval selection:
```
temp = na × t; ni = floor(temp); tc = 2×frac(temp) − 1
```
Evaluates position, velocity, optionally acceleration and jerk (ifl parameter).

## Segment selection
```
nr = floor((et − ss[0]) / ss[2]) + 2    // record number
t  = (et − (nr-2)×ss[2]) / ss[2]        // normalized [0,1]
fseek(fp, nr × record_size, SEEK_SET)
```

## Rust design
```rust
#[cfg(feature = "jpl")]
struct JplReader {
    file: BufReader<File>,
    header: JplHeader,
    record_size: usize,
    cached_record: Option<(usize, Vec<f64>)>,  // (record_nr, coefficients)
}
```
- Cargo feature flag: `jpl` (off by default since JPL files may not be available)
- Reuse swi_echeb/swi_edcheb from Phase 2 (or the more general interp() with sub-intervals)

## Testing
- Only testable if JPL DE files are available. Make tests conditional on file existence.
- Compare JPL vs Swiss Eph output for same dates (should agree very closely)
- Test sub-interval selection edge cases

## C source reference
- swejpl.c:1-958 — swi_open_jpl_file, swi_pleph, swi_close_jpl_file, interp
- swejpl.h:1-103 — structures and constants

## Dependencies
- Phase 0 (types), Phase 2 (Chebyshev), Phase 5 (integration into calc dispatch)
execution_record:
Planning task — decomposed into 4 implement-phase sub-tasks (swisseph-rs/43-46) on this arc, all ready-for-agent/AFK. Created docs/c-ref-jpl.md (the ref doc, via a dedicated sonnet agent reading swejpl.c/.h + the jplplan seam).

Corrections to the original description (it predated the stateless architecture):
- **BufReader → mmap.** Original proposed `BufReader<File>` + `cached_record: Option<(usize, Vec<f64>)>`. Replaced with mmap (mirrors the SwissEphFile/.se1 backend). Resolves the statelessness conflict: OS page cache replaces C's mutable record cache, so no `&mut self`/cache field. Also necessary for the 2.7 GB de441.eph.
- **Cargo `jpl` feature flag dropped.** Decided with Josh: always compile JPL (memmap2 already a dep, pure Rust, codebase has zero feature flags), gate only the golden tests on de441.eph existence. Avoids #[cfg] noise across context.rs/calc.rs.
- **Scope expanded to full end-to-end integration.** Original listed 'Phase 5 integration' as an external dependency. Decided with Josh to include EphemerisSource::Jpl wiring in this arc rather than defer (a reader nobody calls is dead code). Decomposed so the raw reader (43) and swi_pleph (44) are golden-verified against C before integration (46).
- **Shared pipeline, not duplicated.** swisseph-rs/45 refactors calc_*_sweph to run over a PositionProvider trait so JPL reuses the same apparent-position pipeline — mirroring C's app_pos_etc_plan (shared between SWIEPH/JPLEPH). Guarded by the existing calc_sweph.rs golden suite (positions 1e-10) staying green; escape hatch falls back to parallel calc_*_jpl if the refactor moves numbers.
- **Frame compatibility verified.** The shared pipeline consumes barycentric equatorial-J2000 cartesian (precess_and_ephem precesses equatorial directly + frame_bias GcrsToJ2000). JPL DE403+ raw output is ICRF/equatorial-J2000 — compatible. Residual risk (C's icrs2fk5 step on the JPL path) is scoped into JplProvider in task 46, not the shared pipeline.
- **Golden data location.** de441.eph exists ONLY in swisseph-rs/ephe/ (gitignored); ../swisseph/ephe has no .eph file. C harnesses + Rust tests point at CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR/ephe/de441.eph; all JPL tests gated on its existence.
- **DE441 ksize computed generically** (not in swejpl.c's known-ksize table) — task 43 computes it from ipt[] per fsizer.
- **Latent constraint bug flagged:** the backend-isolation forbidden_dep constraints target src/jpl.rs; converting jpl to a directory module makes them inert (same issue already present for src/sweph_file/**). Task 43 updates the patterns to src/jpl/**.

Dependency graph: 44→43; 46→44, 46→45; 43/45 parallelizable. All four refine swisseph-rs/8.
